name: agile-graph
description: Agile Graph (MIT, https://github.com/MILTONADINA/agile-graph) project context for a cloud-backed client such as Claude Code: context_get, symbol_search, graph_neighbors and memory_propose, pinned by agile-graph.tool-hashes.json for @agile-graph/engine 0.1.0. No run tools. Start it from the project root after `agile-graph -C . init --cloud-mcp --export '<glob>'` and `agile-graph -C . index --lexical`. GRAPH_ENGINE_NO_FEEDBACK=1 stops the engine opening public GitHub issues under your account. devops init writes this entry for you (specs/graph/agile-graph-link.md).
